name: Amaze'N Pumpkin Patch
tagline: Autumn At The Arboretum: Best Pumpkin Patch In Texas
description: Amaze'N Pumpkin Patch is an agritourism farm in Willis Ave, TX, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
